taxonomy_summary: Original genus Platypus; subsequent combination in Dinoplatypus documented by Wood (1993).

taxonomic_history.name: Dinoplatypus lepidus
taxonomic_history.note: Wood (1993:273, 279) documents this combination; its first appearance is not established.

taxonomic_history.event: Original description (primary page not directly examined)
taxonomic_history.name: Platypus lepidus
taxonomic_history.note: Original p.282 remains not directly examined.

nomenclature_note: Chapuis (1865:282) original description was not directly examined; Wood (1993:273,279) demonstrates a later Dinoplatypus combination.
